target.title: fix(discord): preserve text after oversized uploads
target.body:
Closes #99021

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Discord replies that include an attachment can be silently lost when Discord rejects the upload as too large. Before this change, the text caption traveled in the same multipart request as the file, so a 413 upload rejection dropped the text too.

## Why This Change Was Made

Discord upload limits vary by guild/account, so this keeps the configured media fetch limit unchanged and adds a last-mile fallback at the Discord send boundary. If Discord rejects the upload as too large, OpenClaw now sends a text-only fallback containing the original text plus a visible note that the attachment was skipped; media-only sends get a visible failure note instead of silence.

## User Impact

Users still see the agent's text reply even when an attached file is over Discord's upload limit. Media-only oversized replies now produce an explicit Discord message explaining that the upload was skipped.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/discord/src/send.sends-basic-channel-messages.test.ts` — PASS, 46 tests.
- `corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --check extensions/discord/src/send.shared.ts extensions/discord/src/send.sends-basic-channel-messages.test.ts` — PASS.
- `corepack pnpm exec oxlint --config .oxlintrc.json --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/discord/src/send.shared.ts extensions/discord/src/send.sends-basic-channel-messages.test.ts` — PASS, 0 warnings/errors.
- `git diff --check` — PASS.
- Diff secret scan — PASS.

No live Discord upload was attempted from this checkout; the regression is covered by deterministic REST-boundary tests that simulate Discord returning HTTP 413 for the media request and verify the follow-up text-only message body.
